notes.title: More Orke Beta v0.7.1
notes.content:
Hello, everyone! The first update for the beta test is here. I tried to address most of the issues that significantly impacted gameplay. Yall's feedback has been incredibly helpful, so if you have any more comments about the game, please feel free to post them in the Discord.

- Fixed a bug preventing the player from buying new land
- Fixed a bug that prevented enemy units and loot from regenerating over time
- Fixed a bug that broke an enemy's attack if you attack the enemy first
- Fixed a bug that showed float values instead of whole numbers in some text
- Slightly lowered the build fx volume. This is a temporary fix until audio settings are added to the game.
- Scouting should now work as intended
